findings.message: No effective timeout on order -> inventory; callers can hang until the gateway gives up.
4 retries without backoff multiplies load on a struggling dependency.
No circuit breaker or fallback on order -> inventory.

diff:
--- a/order-service/config.yaml
+++ b/order-service/config.yaml
@@ -7,6 +7,5 @@ client:
   inventory:
-    timeout_ms: 700
-    retries: 1
-    circuit_breaker: true
-    fallback: true
+    retries: 4
+    circuit_breaker: false
+    fallback: false
comment:
### FLOWGUARD Resilience Check
**Regression.** Resilience 84 -> 32

| Scenario | Base (p95 / errors) | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Database latency | 628 ms / 0.4% | 3000 ms / 92.9% |
| Service down | 369 ms / 0.0% | 206 ms / 100.0% |
| Traffic spike | 2018 ms / 2.8% | 2018 ms / 2.8% |

Top finding: No effective timeout on order -> inventory; callers can hang until the gateway gives up.
Cascade: Database -> Inventory -> Order -> Gateway -> Frontend

Suggested fix: restore timeout_ms 700, bound retries to 1, re-enable breaker and fallback.
